overview: This paper proposes a zero-shot point tracking method that utilizes pretrained video diffusion models by placing a distinctive colored marker at the query point in the first frame and propagating it through counterfactual generation with negative prompting, followed by coarse-to-fine refinement and optional distillation into a fast tracker.

modules.name: Configuration Management
modules.description: Manages global and experimental settings, including dataset paths, model identifiers, noise scheduling parameters, tracking hyperparameters (search radius, marker color), and ablation flags.

modules.name: Video Data Loading & Parsing
modules.description: Loads video frames from TAP-Vid benchmarks (DAVIS, Kinetics) and parses corresponding ground-truth query point coordinates and occlusion states for evaluation.

modules.name: Color Rebalancing Processor
modules.description: Preprocesses input video frames by converting them to HSV color space and reducing the saturation of the marker's color (e.g., red) to minimize false positive detections during tracking.

modules.name: First Frame Point Marking
modules.description: Applies the counterfactual manipulation to the initial video frame by overlaying a distinctive colored marker (e.g., a red dot) at the specified query point coordinates to create the edited conditional input.

modules.name: Diffusion Model Interface
modules.description: Encapsulates the loading and inference logic for off-the-shelf video diffusion models (e.g., Wan2.1, CogVideoX), handling latent encoding, noise prediction, and frame decoding.

modules.name: Counterfactual Noise Estimation
modules.description: Computes two distinct noise estimates during the denoising step: one conditioned on the edited first frame (with marker) and one conditioned on the unedited first frame (original), to prepare for signal enhancement.

modules.name: SDEdit & Negative Prompting Sampler
modules.description: Executes the reverse diffusion process using SDEdit at an intermediate noise level, combining the two noise estimates via negative prompting (weighted subtraction) to ensure the marker persists in the generated video.

modules.name: Simple Color Tracker
modules.description: Extracts the trajectory of the propagated marker from the generated video frames using color thresholding in HSV space, local window searching centered on the previous position, and averaging nearby pixels.

modules.name: Occlusion Handling Logic
modules.description: Manages tracking continuity when the marker disappears, propagating the last known position forward and adaptively expanding the search radius until the marker reappears, then resetting the search window.

modules.name: Inpainting Mask Generator
modules.description: Constructs a spatiotemporal binary mask for the coarse-to-fine refinement stage, marking small regions around the initially tracked points to restrict modifications during the subsequent inpainting diffusion pass.

modules.name: Mask-Constrained Denoising Refinement
modules.description: Re-runs the reverse diffusion process using the generated inpainting mask, blending the denoised latent with the original latent outside the masked region to realign the video spatially and refine the marker position.

modules.name: TAP-Vid Evaluation Metrics
modules.description: Calculates the standard TAP-Vid benchmark metrics, including Average Jaccard (AJ), Positional Accuracy across varying thresholds, and Occlusion Accuracy (OA), comparing predicted tracks against ground truth.

modules.name: Pseudo-Label Trajectory Generator
modules.description: Runs the full zero-shot tracking pipeline on unlabeled video datasets (e.g., Kinetics) to generate high-quality pseudo-label trajectories for distillation purposes.

modules.name: Lightweight Tracker Distillation
modules.description: Trains a specialized, feed-forward tracking network (e.g., CoTracker) from scratch using the generated pseudo-labels, transferring the generative model's temporal reasoning capabilities into a fast inference model.
